## Où j'en suis
The ACK watchdog for QPAY-2291 item 2 is written and tested (14 passing tests, including both DST changes), and it pages on-call if Corvane's ACK is missing 45 minutes after upload. Its PR, quillon/core#1481, is open. It was based on tomer/nacha-validator, and quillon/core#1475 is now merged, so the branch still needs rebasing onto main. The page won't reach anyone until Elad routes the payouts PagerDuty service in terraform. (source: ses-ach-3, quillon/core#1475, quillon/core#1481, src-jira-2291)

- [en-cours] PR #1481 is open with the ACK watchdog, the America/Chicago fix in cutoff.rs, and the runbook edits still to be finished (source: ses-ach-3, quillon/core#1481)
- [prochaine-étape] Rebase quillon/core#1481 onto main, now that quillon/core#1475 is merged (source: ses-ach-3, quillon/core#1475)
- [prochaine-étape] Elad routes the payouts PagerDuty service in terraform (source: ses-ach-3, src-jira-2291)
- [prochaine-étape] Add the names and Vault paths of the watchdog's env vars to docs/runbooks/payout-ack.md, with no values (source: v3-09)
- [prochaine-étape] Rotate the Corvane SFTP password with Elad today, since it appeared in a transcript (source: ses-ach-3, v3-09)
- [prochaine-étape] Write the postmortem doc before the Friday Nov 20 review, 16:00 TLV, where Tomer presents; Loomly wants the written postmortem by Monday Nov 23 (source: src-slack-avi, src-jira-2291)
- [essai-raté] The first validator passed the rejected file because it measured the trimmed record length; it now checks the raw length (source: ses-ach-2, v2-06)
- [essai-raté] The first watchdog test failed because cutoff.rs used a fixed UTC-5 offset, which gave the wrong deadline after DST ended; it now uses America/Chicago (source: v3-04, v3-06)
- [question] The note src-note-truncate says the team agreed to auto-truncate over-long fields, but Avi's message and the decision in v2-03 say fail closed. The note needs correcting (source: src-note-truncate, src-slack-avi, v2-03)
- [décision] The NACHA validator fails closed: it blocks the upload, pages on-call, and a human fixes the config and re-runs (source: v2-03, src-slack-avi)
- [décision] Dates for the upload and deadlines are computed in America/Chicago, never with a fixed offset (source: v3-05)
- [décision] The runbook lists env var names and their Vault paths only, never values (source: v3-09)
